firm_data.firm_description: Copps DiPaola Silverman, PLLC is a family law team committed to providing clients with the highest level of service, both in and out of the courtroom. With nearly 100 years of combined legal knowledge and experience, their team of skilled attorneys stands ready to assist clients.
notable_facts: Available 7 days a week for divorce and family law litigation clients.
Offer video, telephone, and in-person appointments.
Focus on educating clients about the law and their options.

email.subject: AI for Copps DiPaola Silverman - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Ashlee,

I noticed your team handles complex family law matters across divorce, surrogacy, and adoption while staying available 7 days a week for litigation clients. That kind of around-the-clock commitment demands serious operational efficiency.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now working with regional firms in New York. I'd be happy to stop by your Albany office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar practices compete on quality while protecting margins.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
